name: Mike Patrick
role: American on the mountain; Larry thinks a ranger with MACV's special operations group
summary: The tall American at the center of the group photograph on Núi Bà Đen (VN-0010), with an arm around one of the trainees. His son reports Larry thinks he was a ranger, with a special operations group for MACV, and the kind of man people called a ghost or a spook, though Larry doesn't know why. His son also reports that Patrick walked in one day, sat down next to Larry and asked what he had for food; that he was a real character; and that he was above Special Forces, with an outfit his son wrote down as MAGSOG.
researchNotes: Both recollections are his son's paraphrases (giscus-vn-0010-c18035161, 2026-08-15; giscus-vn-0010-c18119905, 2026-08-23), so the summary quotes neither. One of the few people in the archive with both a first and last name, so genuinely searchable. "MAGSOG" is Larry's rendering of MACV-SOG (activated January 1964), which would fit the ghost/spook reputation; treat it as a lead against SOG rosters and association membership lists, not a settled assignment. Still one man's testimony, so the classification does not move. He is a candidate to have known the mountain camp's personnel (Lowry, ledger #4).
